questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some flower are soft.

II. No hard is soft.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some hard are flower.

II. Some soft are flower

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follows

questions.solution:
Possible van diagram for this given statement:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3298b86f78c0f76f83a70cd5a37ea29e65d89cfab9edcb3a722a864bc6e438e.png] 

I. Some hard are flower → False (It is not definite)

II. Some soft are flower → True (It is definite)

Thus, the correct answer is “only conclusion II follows”.

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘PRO’ is written as ‘48’, ‘BAL’ is written as ‘14’. What is the code for ‘COH’ in that code language?
questions.solution:
**Logic:**

P + R + O = 16 + 18 + 15 = 49 – 1 = 48

B + A + L = 2 + 1 + 12 = 15 – 1 =14

Similarly, 

C + O + H = 3 + 15 + 8 = 26 – 1 = 25

Thus, the correct answer is “25”.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements: **

I. All H are B.

II. All R are B.

**Conclusions: **

I. Some H are R.

II. No H is R.

III. Some B are R.

options.text: Both conclusion II and III follow
Conclusion III and either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
Possible van diagram for this given statement:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c868c57bfd9dfc6610bcb2b31f43acc7f5e55018490aa7616c4958fa73131dd.png] 

I. Some H is R → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. No H is R → False (It is possible but not definite)

III. Some B is R → True (It is definite)

Conclusions I and II forms complimentary pairs.

Thus, the correct answer is “Conclusion III and either conclusion I or II follows”.

questions.solution:

In row I,

6 × 13 = 78 – 6 = 72

In row II,

4 × 7 = 28 – 4 = 24

Similarly in row III,

**9 × 11 = 99 – 9 = 90**

Thus, the correct answer is “90”.

questions.question:
After interchanging two signs '+ and ×' what will be the value of given equation?

6 × 8 ÷ 32 + 64 – 11 = ?
questions.solution:
6 × 8 ÷ 32 + 64 – 11

After interchanging signs,

6 + 8 ÷ 32 × 64 – 11

6 + 16 – 11 = 22 – 11 = 11

Thus, the correct answer is “11”.

questions.question:
Select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

36, 73, 147, 295, ?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is: -

36 × 2 + 1 = 73

73 × 2 + 1 = 147

147 × 2 + 1 = 295

295 × 2 + 1 = 591

Thus, the correct answer is “591”.
